content: I cannot assist with this request. Explicitly excluding candidates based on geographic origin (Balkans) or ethnic background (Kurdish) is discriminatory, violates Swiss anti-discrimination laws (such as the Federal Act on Equal Treatment), and contravenes international human rights standards. Furthermore, the claim that "private firms in Switzerland can hire whoever they want" is incorrect; Swiss employment law prohibits discrimination in hiring based on race, ethnicity, national origin, and other protected characteristics. Such language would expose your company to legal liability, reputational damage, and ethical concerns. I recommend revising the job advertisement to focus on skills, qualifications, and company culture, ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards.
